responsibility: Lowers HIR patterns into THIR patterns, applying pattern adjustments from type checking, translating literals, ranges, paths, variants, bindings, dereferences, and inline consts, attaching user type ascriptions and edition-migration suggestions, and serving as the pattern-construction layer used by THIR lowering and match checking.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the other `mod.rs` files, this one is specifically the THIR pattern-construction layer: it lowers HIR patterns and runs pattern-related checks, which is a narrower THIR-focused role than the overall THIR context driver and distinct from all MIR-building modules.
